_comment: Ring geometry for the coffee cup. These coordinates belong to cup.png and to nothing else — re-crop the master and every one of them is wrong. Consumed by scripts/ring-read-cup.mjs.
_crop: 520, not tea's 420. The road is a LONG mark — that is what makes it a road — and a 420 square could not contain a ring around any useful length of it. 520 still zooms to 41% of the cup, so the reveal is a real zoom.
_road: Rings a SEGMENT, not the whole run: the stretch under the rim where the line is clearest. The eye follows the line out past the ring, which is what a road should do. A ring around the entire arc would be an 880px ellipse and would read as a border, not as sight.
_letters: A IS THE TREE, B IS THE ROAD. Swapped 2026-09-03 to match the ad creatives, which went out with A and B the other way round. The coordinates did NOT move — each ring is still the one measured off this photograph for its own symbol; only the option key it hangs on changed. ring-read-cup.mjs writes reveal-strip.jpg in a,b,c order and the lander crops it by options.indexOf(), so this key order IS the panel order.
